summary: Iteration 4 end-to-end testing for AussieBack referral tracking, share analytics, and Instagram Story preset. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (referral code generation, referral linking, share-events CRUD + validation, admin analytics shape + auth guard, and full regression on estimate/leads/stats/export/status update). Frontend: full Playwright flow passes — ?ref=ABCDEFGH captured to localStorage 'ab_ref', sent as referred_by_code on POST /api/leads, Share modal Feed/Story toggle re-renders canvas at 1080x1350 vs 1080x1920, Download button label switches to 'Download Story', share-events fired on interactions with correct channel+aspect, admin analytics panel renders share-channels-card + top-referrers-card, lead detail modal shows modal-referral-code and modal-referred-by rows.

issues: Radix DialogContent emits console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Non-blocking a11y warning — consider adding DialogDescription or aria-describedby=undefined suppressor.

verified_features: POST /api/leads returns a unique 8-char uppercase referral_code matching alphabet [A-HJ-NP-Z2-9] (banned 0/O/1/I). Two consecutive submits produce different codes.
referred_by_code lower-case input is uppercased and resolved to the correct referred_by_lead_id when the code exists; unknown codes pass through with referred_by_lead_id=null.
POST /api/share-events accepts {channel,referral_code,lead_id,aspect} and returns {ok:true,id:<uuid>}; invalid channel returns 422; story_download and story aspect accepted.

GET /api/admin/analytics: 401 without token; with token returns share_events.by_channel for all 4 channels + total (equal to sum) + referrals.top_referrers with lead_id/first_name/email/referral_code/referred_count/total_estimated fields.
Regression: /api/estimate math (working_holiday 65% => 3500 for 10k balance), admin login, /api/admin/leads list, /api/admin/stats, CSV export, PATCH status persistence.
Frontend: /?ref=ABCDEFGH persisted to localStorage 'ab_ref' on mount; complete estimator flow sends referred_by_code:'ABCDEFGH' in POST /api/leads body.

ShareCardModal: aspect-feed / aspect-story toggle switches canvas preview between 1080x1350 and 1080x1920; download label changes to 'Download Story' when Story is active; story_download event fires with aspect='story'.
AdminDashboard: analytics-panel mounts with share-channels-card (4 channels + total + progress bars) and top-referrers-card (list of 3 top referrers with code, referred_count, total_estimated).
Lead detail modal: modal-referral-code and modal-referred-by rows both render correctly (verified with newly submitted IterFour lead: referral_code=2AMJBU4J, referred_by=ABCDEFGH).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard load() uses Promise.all for stats/leads/analytics — good. But no separate error handling if analytics fails specifically; whole dashboard would show 'Failed to load dashboard' even if only analytics 500s. Minor UX concern.

ShareCardModal copyLink uses navigator.clipboard.writeText which fails silently on non-HTTPS or restricted contexts (like headless Playwright). Currently shows toast.error and does NOT fire the share-events 'copy' channel on failure — this is correct behavior but means the 'copy' channel is under-reported when clipboard perms are missing. Consider a document.execCommand fallback.
Referral capture side-effect writes to localStorage on every mount if ?ref= is present — no TTL. Could grow stale attribution weeks later. Consider timestamping and expiring after ~30 days.

backend/server.py: _new_unique_referral_code falls back to _generate_referral_code() + _generate_referral_code()[:2] which produces a 10-char code (violates the 'always 8 chars' contract). Extremely unlikely path but should either raise or truncate to 8.
seed_data_creation: Created 5 test leads via backend tests (TEST_Alice, TEST_Bob, TEST_Charlie referred by Alice, TEST_Dan referred by unknown ZZZZ0000) + 1 frontend lead 'IterFour' referred by ABCDEFGH. Also inserted 2 share-events (feed download + story_download) from pytest suite plus 1 story_download from frontend flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend rate limit is 5/hr per IP for /api/leads — test_referral_analytics.py creates 4 leads which is under the limit. Restart backend to reset slowapi counters if you need to do another submission-heavy pass. The referral alphabet regex is ^[A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{8}$ (excludes 0/O/1/I). Admin dashboard now expects analytics endpoint — if it 500s or 401s, the whole dashboard shows a generic error toast. The AussieBack DB currently has 36 leads including the referred chain (ABCDEFGH -> not resolved; DLBS7KUT-alice / ARCP8F4P / KWMWHAVL as top referrers with 1 referred each).
rca of the issue: No issues found. All Iteration 4 acceptance criteria met.
